_doc: THE one markup adjudication table (R-R3-3, B-136; ruling argo-a5-range-tags R-ART-1..5). Every OggDude bracket token that is not a clean glyph alias, decided by name and matched CASE-EXACT, BEFORE the glyph vocab. as: word = kept verbatim, bracketed, as the source carries it; glyph = becomes [glyph]; drop = removed (the page reader still counts it in its drop table). Read by scripts/canonical/item_markup.py (the item ingest and restore_item_glyphs.py) and by the A5 import (lib/shared/ruleTextLoad.js -> ruleText.js run(opts.markup)). A second copy of these entries anywhere in this repo is a bug (test/argo_a5_import.cjs T2).
